## X-Sense Home Security v1.6.7-12

- Reduce work during MQTT updates by reusing device identity checks across entity platforms and skipping repeated capability checks for entities already added. New fields and device replacements are still picked up.
- Avoid repeated lookups and parsing for paired temperature and humidity settings. Availability and write routes still use current device data.
- Remove the synchronous MQTT drain fallback. Queued reports are delivered in order before unload, with Home Assistant able to run other work between messages.

These changes address reproduced MQTT overhead. They do not establish or resolve the cause of the reported Home Assistant Core restarts.
